question.text: Which of the following is a reliable source of mutual fund performance data, per the workbook?

answer.text: All of these — AMC scheme performance dashboard, AMFI website, and fund factsheets
Only tips from friends and family

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook identifies the AMC's own scheme performance dashboard, the AMFI website, and the fund factsheets as recognised sources of mutual fund performance data. These sources publish verified scheme returns and disclosures. The Trap: Advertisements may highlight only the best-performing periods, while social media posts and tips from friends or relatives are not verified sources of performance data. Investors should always rely on disclosures from AMCs, AMFI and the factsheets. Note: When investors share unverified return figures, point them back to the AMC scheme dashboard, the AMFI website and the latest factsheet to confirm the numbers.
